title: Municipal roadside-verge area and mowing-calendar evidence from Nuenen and Lansingerland

sources.title: Groenbeheerplan 2020–2026
sources.source_location: Section 4.5.2, table on roadside verges and watercourses
sources.reported_data: Municipal verge area categories in m2 and mowing frequencies; categories include 20% left-standing and sinusbeheer.
sources.license: No explicit reuse license identified on the publication page; only limited factual values transcribed with attribution.

sources.title: Maaibeheer
sources.reported_data: Ecological verges are generally mown once or twice yearly; first and second calendar windows are weeks 24–26 and 37–40; safety strips receive three to four cuts with separate week ranges.
sources.license: No explicit reuse license identified on the web page; only factual schedule statements transcribed with attribution.

data_handling: Transcribed reported areas in m2 and calendar windows in ISO week labels; no area conversions, biomass estimates, date interpolation, sum across municipalities, or inference of collected mass was performed.
limitations: Municipalities are contextual comparators and are not the GreenHub contracted catchment.
Area records do not establish harvestable area, biomass yield, collected mass, moisture, accessibility, or collection rights.
Cut-window records are management guidance; they are not observed daily or monthly biomass availability.
Nuenen source years are 2020–2026; Lansingerland schedule is accessed as current web guidance and no explicit publication year is stated.
No explicit reuse license was identified for either source; values are restricted to short factual transcriptions with links.
